name: Infuse Qi and Raise the Flame

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Forging begins with an initial cost of 100 Qi and consumes another 100 Qi per second while operating, in addition to the Qi used by individual heat pulses.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Each heat pulse from a listed flame adds 250°C. However, temperature continuously decreases by 35°C per game tick. If the cultivator lacks sufficient Qi, spirit stones in the inventory may help cover the shortage.
